gradingScales.helpText: Configure letter-grade thresholds and colors for charts and gradebook displays.

schoolYear.intro: Set up a new school year: create classes from the previous year, deactivate old classes, and promote students. Then assign teachers and principals for the new year.

step0.title: 0. Set school year dates
step0.subtitle: These dates are used for performance trends and reports.

teachingWeek.title: 0.1 Set teaching days and weekends
teachingWeek.subtitle: Choose the days when classes run. Unselected days are treated as weekend/non-teaching days.

step2.title: 2. Create classes for new year
step2.subtitle: Creates classes with the same grade/section structure. Teachers are not copied — assign them after.

step3.title: 3. Deactivate previous year classes (optional)
step3.subtitle: Marks all classes for the selected year as inactive. Past data is kept.

step4.title: 4. Promote students
step4.subtitle: Moves active students to the next grade in the new year. Grade 12 students are marked graduated. Enrollment history is preserved.

step6.title: 6. Assign teachers and principals
step6.subtitle: Edit the new year's classes and user roles.
